history.details: Inserted Clause (1-A) defining Block Development Officer, Clause (8-A) defining Deputy Director, Clause (11-A) defining Gram Sevak, and expanded the definitions of Collector, CEO, and Director.
Inserted Clause (12-A) defining Member-Secretary and Clause (20A) defining Taluka Panchayat.
Inserted Clause (1-B) defining Ballot and Electronic Voting Machines.
Substituted Clause (9) regarding Director representation and qualifications.
